prompt: A vertical snapshot from across a wet British terraced street at 3am, cheap 35mm colour film, coarse grain, underexposed, cold teal shadows and green fluorescent glow. A tiny corner shop is the only lit window on the row; every house around it is dark. A hand-written card in the shop window reads "BREAD £50". The shop door stands open onto the empty pavement, warm-white light spilling across a puddle. No people, no cars moving, one sodium streetlamp out. The window display looks lived-in and ordinary, but the open door feels like an invitation. Slight camera shake, horizon a little tilted. Thanks.
